zh.principle: **标准**：高级加密标准（FIPS 197）（Advanced Encryption Standard (FIPS 197)）。FIPS 197 的说明节一句话定性：「The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) … a FIPS-approved cryptographic algorithm that can be used to protect electronic data」并补充「The AES algorithm is a symmetric block cipher that can encrypt (encipher) and decrypt (decipher) digital information.」参数被钉死在块长与密钥长上：「The AES algorithm is capable of using cryptographic keys of 128, 192, and 256 bits to encrypt and decrypt data in blocks of 128 bits.」
zh.why: 标准的由来写在摘要里：「In 2000, NIST announced the selection of the Rijndael block cipher family as the winner of the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) competition.」——这是一次公开竞赛的结果，而不是内部指定；摘要还说明分组密码是很多密码服务的基础。
zh.used: 结构层面的口径很窄：§3.5 定义字与块——「A word is a sequence of four bytes; a block consists of four words.」实现义务则是「An implementation of the AES algorithm shall support at least one of the three key lengths … 128, 192, or 256 bits (i.e., Nk = 4, 6, or 8, respectively).」，其余档位只是可选项：「Implementations may optionally support two or three key lengths, which may promote the interoperability of algorithm implementations.」
zh.broken: FIPS 197 只管算法本体：§8 实现注意要求「The algorithm shall be used in conjunction with a FIPS-approved or NIST-recommended mode of operation.」，模式与工作方式是另一批文件；§6.3 把本版取值写死——「the allowed values for the key length (Nk), block size (Nb), and number of rounds (Nr)」——但同段立刻留了口子：「However, future revisions of this Standard could include changes or additions to the allowed values for those parameters.」封闭的是本版参数集，不是未来版本。
zh.history: 版本史与身份在文首：文档名为「Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) (FIPS 197)」，类别行是「Computer Security Standard, Cryptography」，批准权属写明「4.Approving Authority.Secretary of Commerce.」，维护机构为 NIST 的信息技术实验室；本轮所读即 2023 年更新的 upd1 版本，摘要仍把入选时间记为 2000 年；文件末尾的修订说明写明这是一次编辑性更新：原 197 号经 NIST 加密出版物评审委员会复审，公开意见与 NIST IR 8319 所描述的 AES 安全性分析构成`保持技术规定不变`这一决定的依据。

en.principle: **Standard**: Advanced Encryption Standard (FIPS 197) (高级加密标准（FIPS 197）). The explanation clause of FIPS 197 defines it in one sentence: "The Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) … a FIPS-approved cryptographic algorithm that can be used to protect electronic data." It adds "The AES algorithm is a symmetric block cipher that can encrypt (encipher) and decrypt (decipher) digital information." and pins the parameters: "The AES algorithm is capable of using cryptographic keys of 128, 192, and 256 bits to encrypt and decrypt data in blocks of 128 bits."
en.why: The origin is in the abstract: "In 2000, NIST announced the selection of the Rijndael block cipher family as the winner of the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) competition." — the outcome of an open competition rather than an internal designation; the abstract also notes that block ciphers underpin many cryptographic services.
en.used: The structural vocabulary is narrow: §3.5 defines words and blocks — "A word is a sequence of four bytes; a block consists of four words." The implementation duty is stated as "An implementation of the AES algorithm shall support at least one of the three key lengths … 128, 192, or 256 bits (i.e., Nk = 4, 6, or 8, respectively)." while the other sizes stay optional: "Implementations may optionally support two or three key lengths, which may promote the interoperability of algorithm implementations."
en.broken: FIPS 197 covers the algorithm only: clause 8 requires that "The algorithm shall be used in conjunction with a FIPS-approved or NIST-recommended mode of operation.", leaving modes and operation to other documents. §6.3 fixes this edition’s parameters — "the allowed values for the key length (Nk), block size (Nb), and number of rounds (Nr)" — but the very next sentence keeps the future open: "However, future revisions of this Standard could include changes or additions to the allowed values for those parameters." What is closed is this edition, not later ones.
en.history: The identity and authority sit at the head of the file: the name line is "Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) (FIPS 197)", the category line reads "Computer Security Standard, Cryptography", approval is stated as "4. Approving Authority. Secretary of Commerce." with maintenance at NIST’s Information Technology Laboratory; the copy read here is the 2023 upd1 revision, whose abstract still dates the selection to 2000; the revision note at the end of the file records an editorial update: the original 197 was reviewed under NIST’s Crypto Publication Review Board, and public comments plus the AES security analyses in NIST IR 8319 were the basis for the decision to keep the technical specifications unchanged.

zh: AES：FIPS 197 批准的对称分组密码算法。
Rijndael：被选为 AES 的分组密码族。
state/word：16 字节状态与 4 字节字的结构单位。
mode：与算法配合使用的工作模式。
en: AES: the symmetric block cipher approved by FIPS 197.
Rijndael: the block-cipher family selected as AES.
State/word: the 16-byte state and its 4-byte words.
Mode: the operation paired with the algorithm.
upd1: the update marker of FIPS 197.
